scope: sanitized production research plus deterministic local fixtures

incident.payloadRetentionNote: Only a 500-character raw preview was retained.

candidateRecoverability.reason: No canonical provider ID, address, or trusted coordinates survived in the retained preview; country/category/confidence and at least one explicit-evidence object were present.

final.userTitle: We couldn't pin this one down

productionSample.causalityWarning: Association is not causation; only the named incident is confirmed as a validation-to-insufficient conflation.

fixtures.name: name:too_small
fixtures.currentBehavior: Whole candidate rejected; if no sibling survives, Sol runs and an empty Sol result becomes insufficient_evidence.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Retain typed partial evidence, attempt deterministic rehydration, then expose a non-saveable area/search lead or a technical recovery state.
fixtures.recommendedRecoveryPath: provider identity -> address/provider coordinates -> field normalization -> bounded evidence-grounded repair -> area/search lead

fixtures.name: name missing but Place ID present
fixtures.currentBehavior: Whole candidate rejected; the worker schema has no Place ID field.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Rehydrate canonical name and fields from the provider ID, retaining provenance.

fixtures.name: name missing but coordinates/address present
fixtures.idealBehavior: Use address or provider-sourced coordinates for canonical lookup; never trust model coordinates as canonical.

fixtures.name: malformed category
fixtures.idealBehavior: Set category to null and preserve identity evidence.

fixtures.name: malformed evidence list
fixtures.currentBehavior: Bare/misshapen items are dropped, but object-shaped items with empty/oversize values survive normalization and can reject the whole candidate.

fixtures.name: partial candidate
fixtures.currentBehavior: Can parse, but without explicit evidence it renders zero places and becomes insufficient_evidence.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Preserve it as a typed noncanonical lead only when its text has observable provenance.

fixtures.name: parser-invalid JSON
fixtures.currentBehavior: Gemini path records gemini_json_parse_failed as empty evidence; fallback may run, and an empty fallback can be presented as evidence insufficiency.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Classify MALFORMED_MODEL_OUTPUT and repair/retry/fallback before any evidence conclusion.
fixtures.recommendedRecoveryPath: bounded structured repair then provider fallback

fixtures.name: provider timeout
fixtures.currentBehavior: Retryable MediaError requeues until max attempts, then finalizes failed.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Keep technical classification and user retry state after exhaustion.

fixtures.name: Places failure
fixtures.currentBehavior: All-provider-error paths retry; exhausted failures are technical, but some region expansion failures can disappear into no-hypothesis/insufficient paths.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Persist PLACES_RESOLUTION_FAILURE separately while retaining partial candidates/leads.

fixtures.name: genuine insufficient evidence
fixtures.currentBehavior: Accepted empty evidence routes to analysis_insufficient.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Only reach true no-useful-evidence after the technical ladder succeeds and no grounded candidate, region, or lead exists.

fixtures.name: weak region-only evidence
fixtures.currentBehavior: Preserved and triggers only_coarse_geography Sol escalation; it is not a canonical destination.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Retain as an AREA MATCH/likely-area result if no better candidate emerges.

fixtures.name: one valid plus one malformed candidate
fixtures.currentBehavior: Valid sibling survives and prevents insufficientEvidence from being forced true.
fixtures.idealBehavior: Keep this behavior and additionally salvage safe fields inside the malformed sibling.
